narrative_prose: Ryn wiped oxidized copper dust from her brow, staring out at the churning chaos below where the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea threw towering obsidian spikes into the violet sky. The acrid stench of ozone burned her nostrils, competing with the warm, yeasty aroma of the Feast loaves she had to deliver before the night shift missed its precise caloric baseline. Grabbing her heavy steel climbing anchor, she pivoted as Silas approached through the static-charged fog. She shoved the rusted baton squarely into his chest, barking, 'Take this and secure the relay, Silas, unless you want to eat cold slag for supper!'

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: deliver Feast loaves across the ridge

active_location.macro_silhouette: The exterior ridge of the colony offered a terrifying view of the volatile exoplanet. Below, the vast expanse was dominated by the churning black mirror of the ferrofluid sea. The Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea created towering spikes that collapsed just as quickly under the violet sky.
